description: GeoSciML is a data model and data transfer standard for geological data, from basic map data to complex relational geological databases. The current version 4.1 comes with the OGC implementation specification, a UML model and Enterprise Architect file, XML schemas held at the OGC schema repository and encoding examples, guides for serving GeoSciML web feature services with GeoServer and an encoding cookbook for OneGeology and INSPIRE, and a GeoSciML-Lite package for simple WFS and WMS services; versions go back to 1.0.0 in 2005, and a Chinese translation was made by the China Geological Survey. It is maintained by the IUGS Commission for the Management and Application of Geoscience Information. Coverage is global. The documents and schemas are available free online; the page read gives CGI copyright for the site but no licence for the standard. Caveats: it defines structures, so data quality depends on each survey, and the site shows little activity since 2021. For simulation it lets geological maps from different surveys be combined for ground hazard, mining and foundation models of infrastructure. It is related to the EarthResourceML standard record in this catalogue, its companion for mineral resources.
